title: Machine Learning Model to Identify Sepsis Patients in the Emergency Department: Algorithm Development and Validation
summary: Development included 8,296 patients and a separate external cohort of 1,744, with AUC 0.86 internal and 0.75 external. External validation performance was lower; the authors note heterogeneity and the need for prospective interventional evaluation.
ai_technology: XGBoost uses emergency-department clinical data to identify sepsis against a Sepsis-3 reference standard.
